## About {.unnumbered}

The YAML header sets the viewer's colors without CSS, giving a deep blue
backdrop, a cream caption band, dark brown caption text, and rust links. Every
image on the page gets them.

```yaml
panzoom:
  backdrop: "rgba(18, 52, 86, 0.92)"  # deep blue
  caption-background: "#f4e9d8"       # cream
  caption-color: "#3b2a1a"            # dark brown
  link-color: "#a0361b"               # rust
```

Each option sets one of the viewer's CSS variables. [Styling with
CSS](n-css-class.html) sets the same variables from a stylesheet, for some pages
only. A single image or code cell can set its own colors, which apply while that
image is open ([case 2](#c2) and [case 4](#c4)).

## Markdown image {#c1 expect-open="panzoom" expect-overlay="rgba(18, 52, 86, 0.92)" expect-band="rgb(244, 233, 216)"}

A markdown image with `.panzoom`. It opens with the colors set on this page, a
deep blue backdrop and a cream caption band, and the link in its caption is
rust.

```markdown {.show-source}
![Chilmark beach at sunset, with a [link](https://quarto.org).](../../images/mv-0.jpg){.panzoom fig-alt="Sunset over a sandy beach, with a tall rock stack against the sun"}
```

## Colors for one image {#c2 expect-open="panzoom" expect-overlay="rgba(20, 60, 40, 0.92)" expect-band="rgb(232, 243, 234)"}

A markdown image with `.panzoom` and colors of its own, set as attributes. It
opens with a deep green backdrop and a pale green caption band instead of the
colors set on this page, and the link in its caption is dark green.

```markdown {.show-source}
![Aquinnah, with colors of its own and a [link](https://quarto.org).](../../images/mv-1.jpg){.panzoom backdrop="rgba(20, 60, 40, 0.92)" caption-background="#e8f3ea" caption-color="#173d24" link-color="#0b6b3a" fig-alt="Waves breaking below grassy clay cliffs at Aquinnah"}
```

## Code cell {#c3 expect-open="panzoom" expect-overlay="rgba(18, 52, 86, 0.92)" expect-band="rgb(244, 233, 216)"}

An R cell with `#| panzoom: true`. It opens with the blue and cream colors set
on this page.

```{r}
#| fig-alt: "Scatter plot of vapor pressure rising steeply with temperature"
#| panzoom: true
#| fig-cap: "Vapor pressure, from a cell with `panzoom: true`."

plot(pressure, type = "b", pch = 19)
```

## Colors for one cell {#c4 expect-open="panzoom" expect-overlay="rgba(70, 25, 15, 0.92)" expect-band="rgb(251, 233, 220)"}

An R cell with colors of its own under the `panzoom` cell option. It opens with
a dark red backdrop and a peach caption band.

```{r}
#| fig-alt: "Scatter plot of stopping distance against speed for 50 cars"
#| panzoom:
#|   backdrop: "rgba(70, 25, 15, 0.92)"
#|   caption-background: "#fbe9dc"
#|   caption-color: "#4a1f10"
#| fig-cap: "Stopping distance against speed, with colors of its own."

plot(cars, pch = 19)
```

## Gallery with mixed colors {#c5 expect-open="panzoom" expect-steps="true"}

A gallery of three images. The first has a deep green backdrop and a pale green
caption band of its own, the second has no colors of its own and shows the blue
and cream set on this page, and the third has a dark red backdrop and a peach
band of its own. Each image shows its colors while it is open, and stepping to
the next or previous one doesn't keep them.

```markdown {.show-source}
![The Edgartown lighthouse, with colors of its own.](../../images/mv-2.jpg){.panzoom group="mixed" backdrop="rgba(20, 60, 40, 0.92)" caption-background="#e8f3ea" caption-color="#173d24" fig-alt="A white lighthouse against a blue sky" expect-overlay="rgba(20, 60, 40, 0.92)" expect-band="rgb(232, 243, 234)"}

![A gingerbread cottage, with the colors set on this page.](../../images/mv-3.jpg){.panzoom group="mixed" fig-alt="A shingled gingerbread cottage with pink and green trim, behind a garden path" expect-overlay="rgba(18, 52, 86, 0.92)" expect-band="rgb(244, 233, 216)"}

![A sailboat, with colors of its own.](../../images/mv-4.jpg){.panzoom group="mixed" backdrop="rgba(70, 25, 15, 0.92)" caption-background="#fbe9dc" caption-color="#4a1f10" fig-alt="A sailboat with a flag-striped sail off a sandy beach" expect-overlay="rgba(70, 25, 15, 0.92)" expect-band="rgb(251, 233, 220)"}
```
